tools.name: memory_brief
tools.title: Substrate brief
tools.description: The cross-agent session briefing for a repo: this graph's nodes and claims, other open graphs, recent agent actions, decisions in force and warnings. Call this before your first action in a repo.

surface.description: defaults to the caller's own surface

tools.name: memory_write
tools.title: Write a memory entry
tools.description: Record a decision, fact, warning, handoff or todo at a scope so other agents see it in their brief. Gated by memory policy: returns {status: 'accepted'|'conflict'|'quarantined'|'denied', entry?, reason?, remedy?}.

surface.description: defaults to the caller's own surface

tools.name: memory_search
tools.title: Search memory
tools.description: Full-text search over memory entries, optionally narrowed to one scope.

tools.name: events_emit
tools.title: Emit an event
tools.description: Append a normalised event to the substrate's append-only event ledger. Redaction and the hash chain are applied on ingest, and this tool is the only way to write to the ledger. The reply's `stored` says whether the append landed — false means the event was normalised but not persisted.

tools.name: graph_get
tools.title: Get a graph
tools.description: Task, nodes, steps, claims and PR state for a Graph ID.

tools.name: graph_register
tools.title: Register a graph
tools.description: Record a Graph ID and its nodes/steps in the index after the Notion and Linear rows exist. Idempotent by Graph ID — re-running updates in place rather than duplicating.

tools.name: graph_claim
tools.title: Claim a node
tools.description: Claim a Graph-of-Thought node for this surface. Phase 2: returns lease (expires, token) or existing. CAS prevents overwrite.

tools.name: graph_release
tools.title: Release a node
tools.description: Drop this surface's claim on a node without marking it complete.

tools.name: graph_complete
tools.title: Complete a node
tools.description: Mark a node completed and drop its claim.

tools.name: graph_heartbeat
tools.title: Heartbeat lease
tools.description: Refresh lease TTL for active claim using token from claim result.

tools.name: graph_handoff
tools.title: Signed handoff packet
tools.description: Record/return a signed handoff for a node (goal, files, DoD, blockers, prev_hash). Phase 2 stub.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.title: Search product docs
tools.description: Retrieval against RAGFlow. Returns citations when a dataset answers, or a clear error when the plane is not configured.
